Bug_Title: "getClass" should not be used for synchronization
Bug_Explanation: The 'getClass' method is used for synchronization in non-final classes. This can result in multiple threads entering the synchronized block at once.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by calling the showBug method which in turn calls the doSomethingSynchronized method which synchronizes on the getClass object. The getClass method returns a different object for each class instance, which can lead to problems when multiple threads try to synchronize on the same object.
